_: Generated by extension/scripts/changelog.mjs from docs/release-notes. Do not edit; change the notes and run the script.

items: Added a Tutor and Interviewer switch to the Tutor tab header. Switching starts a new conversation.
Added editable prompts: change the tutor prompt or the interviewer prompt in Settings, and reset either one to its default whenever you like.
Gave every model the full tutor prompt by default.
Made Sync from LeetCode turn red and read "LeetCode not logged in" when you are signed out, and showed when it last synced.
Made removing the extension open a page with the one command that removes the helper, and made the helper uninstall clear its cached copy too.
Added this Changelog tab, a badge on the toolbar icon and a card in the Tutor tab that appear after an update.
Tidied the Settings page: one Model section, then Prompts, Helper and a collapsed Advanced section.

Made the helper keep itself up to date (version 0.1.6 and later): it checks npm once a day and installs a newer version when nothing is using it. Settings shows its version, an Update now button and a switch to turn this off.
Told you in Settings when the helper is too old for this version of the extension, with the command to update it.
Fixed installing the helper again deleting its saved settings and API keys.
Merged the two model lists in Settings into one: pick the model you want, and only its settings show below the list.
Made Settings save by themselves as you change them, so there is no Save button. The prompts still have their own Save, since saving one starts a new conversation.
Made the tutor Socratic: it asks guiding questions, and says plainly whether your runtime is already the best possible when you Submit or ask.
Added a helper for the Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions that you set up from the Settings page, plus install scripts for Chrome and the helper.
Made Check again show that it is working, and unlock Save as soon as the helper is running.
Added a dropdown of Claude model names (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku) to the Claude subscription settings.
Explained a missing Claude or Codex sign-in instead of failing quietly.
Made open Tutor tabs reload themselves after the helper is set up.
Numbered each Submit on its own in the review chip, apart from the Runs before it.
Fixed the helper uninstall leaving files behind, and several Settings layout and wording problems.
Added Sync from LeetCode on the Progress tab, which marks every problem your account has accepted.
Turned the Progress title into a problem set menu (NeetCode 150, Blind 75, Grind 75, Top Interview 150, SQL 50).
Added a Progress button to the Tutor header, and made the gear open Settings.
Renamed the extension to Thomson's LeetCode Tutor.
